plan.experiment: External-reference-Q real-waveform adaptation and controlled added attenuation
plan.Q_selection: Published alpha=0 Z-component results, not re-estimated from trial windows
plan.adaptation: Stationary single-path tstar operator; offset stage is identity; optimized dictionary W=I estimates an unknown band-limited source pulse, not layered reflectivity or Ricker atoms.
plan.optimized_penalty: Unchanged core: .5*sqrt(2*log(nt))*sigma, support refit and group pruning
plan.evaluation_records: Remaining 3 records; two earthquakes total, not four independent events
plan.rule: No parameter tuning based on controlled-test errors. Published Q is an estimated reference, not physical ground truth.
plan.controlled_reference: Band-limited real observed P-wave window, already attenuated by nature; recovery only reverses newly added attenuation.
plan.full_path_quality: Report replay residual, amplitude gain, background response and tstar sensitivity, not truth error or measured SNR improvement.
